units.title: SG-5.3 Wire dust, ambient light and fade transition from content
Act: Add effectSchema and bedroom effects content
Act: Add Phaser effect context and wire it into BootScene
Verify: Effects schema and bedroom content unit tests

tests.id: effectsSchema.test.ts > effectsSchema > accepts a scene carrying dust, ambientLight and fade effects
tests.name: effectsSchema: valid effects accepted
tests.title: accepts a scene carrying dust, ambientLight and fade effects
tests.scenario: Given a valid scene with dust, ambientLight and fade effects, When validated as scene content, Then validation succeeds

tests.id: effectsSchema.test.ts > effectsSchema > accepts a scene that omits effects entirely
tests.name: effectsSchema: absent effects accepted
tests.title: accepts a scene that omits effects entirely
tests.scenario: Given a valid scene with no effects key, When validated, Then validation succeeds

tests.id: effectsSchema.test.ts > effectsSchema > rejects a fade transition with a negative durationMs and points at effects.0
tests.name: effectsSchema: invalid effect rejected at effects.0
tests.title: rejects a fade transition with a negative durationMs and points at effects.0
tests.scenario: Given a scene whose first effect is a fade transition with durationMs -1, When validated, Then validation fails and the first error path starts with effects.0

tests.id: effectsSchema.test.ts > bedroom effects content > declares dust, ambientLight and transition effects on the bedroom scene
tests.name: bedroom effects content: dust, ambientLight, transition present
tests.title: declares dust, ambientLight and transition effects on the bedroom scene
tests.scenario: Given the-boys-room world loaded via loadWorld, When the bedroom scene is located, Then its effect types include dust, ambientLight and transition

units.title: Verify: buildEffects unit tests with a fake effect context

tests.name: buildEffects creates one non-transition effect per authored spec on the effects layer and skips the transition
tests.title: buildEffects creates one non-transition effect per authored spec on the effects layer and skips the transition
tests.scenario: Given a fake context and dust, ambientLight and fade effects; When buildEffects runs; Then createEffect is called twice with depth 400, playTransition is not called, and two handles are returned
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildEffects.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: buildEffects returns no handles and makes no calls when the scene has no effects
tests.title: buildEffects returns no handles and makes no calls when the scene has no effects
tests.scenario: Given a scene with no effects key; When buildEffects runs; Then zero handles are returned and no context method is called
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildEffects.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: exposes a destroy function on every created handle that can be torn down
tests.title: exposes a destroy function on every created handle that can be torn down
tests.scenario: Given a fake context whose created handles carry destroy spies; When every returned handle is destroyed; Then each destroy spy is called exactly once
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildEffects.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: BootScene effect wiring and Phaser context unit tests

tests.name: BootScene effects > builds the scene effects from the bundled bedroom scene when create() runs
tests.title: builds the scene effects from the bundled bedroom scene when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given a BootScene with state in the store, when create() runs, then buildEffects is called once with the bundled scene and a context exposing createEffect and playTransition

tests.name: BootScene effects > destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given create() has registered effect handles, when the captured SHUTDOWN callback runs, then destroy is called once on each handle

tests.name: playTransition: fade-in and ambient layer on the Phaser scene > playTransition(400) starts the main camera fade-in for 400 ms
tests.title: playTransition(400) starts the main camera fade-in for 400 ms
tests.scenario: Given a fake Phaser scene with cameras.main.fadeIn, when playTransition(400) is called, then fadeIn is called with 400

tests.name: playTransition: fade-in and ambient layer on the Phaser scene > createEffect for ambientLight adds a full-scene rectangle with the authored depth
tests.title: createEffect for ambientLight adds a full-scene rectangle with the authored depth
tests.scenario: Given a fake Phaser scene, when createEffect is called with an ambientLight spec at depth 7, then add.rectangle is called with the scene size and colour and the rectangle's setDepth receives 7

units.title: REQ · Scene content declares dust, ambient light and a fade transition with validation

REQ · Phaser BootScene creates scene effects from content and cleans them up
